item.title: Oscars 2027 priority watchlist
item.description:
My personal watchlist for the Oscars 2027, thanks to Next Best Picture and Variety. The list started off with NBP's list of early contenders and Variety's first blind predictions for 2027's nominees in the feature length categories (except for Original Song). After that I update weekly based on NBP's predictions (top 20 in Best Picture, top 10 in all other categories), supplemented by Variety's top 20 in Best Picture until the actual unseen nominees remain after nomination morning.

Latest update: November 4

NOTE: it's a personal watchlist, so whenever I see a film from this list, it will be removed.

(sorted by average rating)
